items.text: Mohammadreza Morad Behroozi, a citizen of Qazvin, was summoned to the 14th investigative branch of the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office of Qazvin County. He must appear within five days to defend against the charge of "disrupting prison order." The summons was issued on Tuesday, October 13.

A group of Iranians living in Germany protested against executions in Iran on Tuesday, October 13, in Hanover. They expressed their support for Prince Reza Pahlavi. A video of this protest was sent to Iran International.

Ramazan Sharif, advisor to the commander of the IRGC, stated that there is no prospect for American victory in the war and that the US will accept the Islamic Republic's conditions. He added that American facilities around Iran are out of operation and their bases are unusable. Regarding the killing of Ali Khamenei in the 40-day war, he said the enemies took a great risk and will pay a heavy price.

CENTCOM announced that Special Unit 99 of the US Air Force Central Command provides new drone and communication capabilities to operational forces in the Middle East. This special unit operates as a laboratory for innovative ideas in the region. The goal is to enhance combat effectiveness on the battlefield.

Young job seekers from the city of Har in Shush held a protest in front of the Sugarcane Development and Related Industries Company in Ahvaz. The protesters demanded job opportunities at the Haft-Tappeh complex. These young people face unemployment and difficulties in covering living expenses.

Forough Ram, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Zahedan, was transferred to Zahedan prison to serve a one-year sentence. She was convicted due to posting stories about the December 1404 protests. During the trial, her lawyer was not allowed to enter the court session.

Kepler data analysis company announced that Chinese refineries have increased crude oil purchases from the Middle East. Since mid-September, Chinese buyers have purchased at least 80 million barrels of Saudi crude oil. This increased demand may prevent further declines in Dubai crude oil prices.

Officials in Sistan and Baluchestan reported the killing of Afsaneh Aghila, a female Basij commander, and Mohammad Ali Shahriari, a police officer, in two separate attacks in Mehrestan county. Afsaneh Aghila was shot dead in front of her home, and Mohammad Ali Shahriari was killed in an attack on a police vehicle. These incidents occurred on Wednesday, October 14.

The Hormozgan governorate confirmed that three people were injured in an incident involving an unidentified drone in the waters of Sirik. A fishing vessel was targeted and the injured were transferred to the shore. It was also reported that the IRGC uses unarmed lookouts on boats to identify targets.

The Israeli Prime Minister stated that an attack on Iran before the elections is not suitable for Israel. He announced that if re-elected, he will destroy Hamas, Hezbollah, and the Iranian regime. Times of Israel noted past efforts by Israel and the US to downplay the possibility of an attack on Iran.

The head of the emergency center in Torbat Heydariyeh announced that 60% of the 39 ambulances in the city are worn out, with some over 15 years old. Last year, five new ambulances were added to the fleet. There is a need for four to five more ambulances to improve services.

The IRGC Navy announced that the container ship GFS Pride struck a mine and sank on the morning of Wednesday, October 14, in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz. The ship was carrying over 2,500 containers and was navigating an unauthorized route. Additionally, the bulk carrier Cape Dao is sinking, and Iran is using new tactics to target ships in the area.

The executive deputy of Pezeshkian, referring to the scope of sanctions and the US naval blockade, stated that it must be assumed that oil can no longer be sold and the economy must be run without oil.

Ali Shirazi stated that hardline supporters of Khamenei have targeted Hassan Rouhani due to his government's negotiations with the US. They consider Rouhani as a possible option for compromise with Washington. This issue was raised at a gathering of regime supporters.

The second week of hearings for three Iranian defendants accused of gathering information and harming Iran International journalists is underway at Woolwich Court in London. Mostafa Sepahvand, one of the defendants, denied collecting information for a foreign country and spoke of being tortured by British police. He also cursed the Islamic Republic and mentioned having suicidal thoughts.

A citizen criticized the 45-day delay of the OMP Finex exchange in rial settlement. He said that the promise to activate the user support fund and send him a message was made but has not been fulfilled.

Yadollah Javani, the political deputy of the IRGC, stated that this war is not a world war in form but its consequences are evaluated at the level of a world war. He added that Iran and the resistance front will emerge victorious from this battle and the armed forces are ready to respond to any enemy mistakes. He also said Iran has passed the stage of the risk of a surprise military attack.

Fatemeh Jami, a prisoner in Gorgan, needs surgery due to a cyst in her chest but has been deprived of medical care. Her physical condition is poor, and her family has been unable to secure medical leave for her. This information was reported to Harana News Agency by an informed source.

Mohammad Jafar Qaempanah, executive deputy of Masoud Pezeshkian, stated in a meeting in Tabriz that there are two views on negotiation, but the system does not accept this dichotomy. Final decisions on important issues, including missile strikes and negotiations, are made by the Supreme National Security Council and the Supreme Leader. He emphasized that missiles will be launched if ordered by the leader, and negotiations will occur if deemed appropriate.

A legal case has been filed against Saeed Shakiba, a blogger and satirist, in Tehran's prosecutor's office. The case concerns a humorous video mimicking the voice of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, the second leader of the Islamic Republic, accused of being insulting. The case is based on the publication of offensive and abusive content.

A video shows the mother of Mohammad Mahdi Mardani kissing her son's tombstone and decorating his grave with flowers. Mohammad Mahdi Mardani was killed on January 8, 2026, at Hasan Khan Castle in Tehran. This incident was carried out by agents of the Islamic Republic.

The Hamburg State Supreme Court has begun hearing the case of the Nord Stream gas pipeline explosion. The accused exercised the right to remain silent and did not answer any questions on the first day of the trial. This report was provided by Ahmad Samadi from Iran International.

Tehran is experiencing severe GPS service disruptions, making it difficult for Snapp drivers to work. People complain about increased economic restrictions and difficulties in receiving salaries and unemployment insurance. Additionally, in Ardabil, faculty members of Mohaghegh University left classes, leaving students without classes.

Eyal Zamir, Chief of Staff of the Israeli army, stated that the army is highly prepared to launch a broad offensive operation against any party targeting Israeli citizens. He mentioned increased security alerts and the likelihood of intensified clashes. Israeli forces are ready to counter surprise attacks, and the 98th Division has been deployed in the West Bank.

Donald Trump announced the possibility of a stronger action against the Islamic Republic after more than seven months of conflict and failed negotiations. At the same time, CENTCOM reported the activation of Special Force 99 in the Middle East. These details were shared in an interview with Maryam Rahmati.

CENTCOM rejected the Iranian ambassador's claims about threatening behavior by American forces towards Iranian sailors. CENTCOM stated that Iran is the only country attacking civilian sailors in the region's waters. Commercial ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continues under the protection of American forces and regional partners.

A group of spectators remained outside the doors of Takhti Stadium in Khorramabad and were not allowed to enter by the officers. The officers dispersed the spectators using stun guns and batons. This was reported to Iran International by a witness.

Netanyahu spoke about the possibility of an attack on Iran after the Israeli elections following Trump's remarks about heavy strikes on the Islamic Republic. At the same time, the Ground Command account of the IRGC confirmed the possibility of a US ground attack. These developments have been raised in the regional political context.

The fourth anniversary of Mehran Abbaspoor Aghdam was commemorated at his grave. He died in October 2022 during a fire and violent clashes between security forces and prisoners at Lakan Prison in Rasht. The event was shared on social media.

Mohammad Khatami criticized the Islamic Republic's intervention in the Palestine issue, stating that Iran should not represent the Palestinian people. He considered this interference harmful to the Iranian nation and does not accept it. Although he criticized Israel's legitimacy, he denied Iran's right to intervene in the Palestinian crisis.

The match between Persepolis and Kheybar Khorramabad in the seventh week of the Premier League ended in a goalless draw. The game was held at Takhti Stadium in Khorramabad, and Persepolis reached the top of the table with 17 points. Tiwi Bifuma missed a key scoring chance, and Kheybar's goalkeeper Mohammadreza Dinarvand had an outstanding performance.

A letter has been sent to production companies announcing that gas supply to industrial towns will soon be cut off, and factories must find alternative fuel. In areas like Pakdasht and Khuzestan, there are educational problems including lack of textbooks and specialized teachers. Additionally, power outages in Gohardasht have caused damage to household appliances.

Mousa Al-Reza Zoghi Moghadam, a 64-year-old resident of Mashhad, was arrested on Tuesday, October 13, by security forces and transferred to Vakilabad prison. He is accused of "assembly and collusion." His family has been informed of a 400 million toman bail for his temporary release.

In the second week of the UEFA Champions League, Manchester City will host Paris Saint-Germain. In the last five encounters, Manchester City has won three times and Paris Saint-Germain twice. This match will take place tonight.

The fourth preliminary trial session of Mehran Mohaqqeqi, accused of attacking protesters with a car in Richmond Hill, was held. The incident occurred in May, resulting in one injury. Mohaqqeqi was holding the Islamic Republic flag at the time of the incident.

Persepolis reached the top of the Premier League table with 17 points and a better goal difference than Tractor. Esteghlal is the only undefeated team in the first 8 weeks of the league. Zob Ahan, Shams Azar, Esteghlal Khuzestan, Mes Shahrbabak, and Sanat Naft Abadan are in the danger zone.

Ali Kazemi stated that disrespect to national symbols and the flag of the Islamic Republic is being addressed by the judiciary. These cases are pursued under charges such as propaganda against the regime or insulting sacred values. A bill for more precise criminalization will be submitted to the parliament.

Two Singapore-flagged container ships were hit by projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz. The ship "GFS Pride" sank on October 13, with all crew safely evacuated. The ship "GFS Giselle" was damaged on October 14 but reached a safe anchorage with its crew unharmed.

An Iranian citizen sent a video to Iran International congratulating Empress Farah Pahlavi's birthday. He invited Iranians abroad to attend an event in Frankfurt on November 7. This day coincides with the awarding of the German Freedom Prize to Prince Reza Pahlavi.

Branch 15 of Tehran Revolutionary Court has reissued the death sentence for political prisoner Varisheh Moradi. Her lawyers stated that the Supreme Court investigations have not been conducted. Moradi was sentenced on charges of membership in a rebellious group.

Saeed Golsorkhi's mother joined the '9 apples, 9 months of separation' campaign. She said one apple is in memory of her son who was killed on January 12, 2026, in Shahroud. Saeed Golsorkhi was killed by officers at the age of 31.

Volodymyr Zelensky said it is painful when Donald Trump takes a side other than Ukraine in the Ukraine-Russia war. These remarks came after Trump said Zelensky should be replaced. Zelensky also stated that if Trump is in the middle, he should stay in the middle.

The deputy police commander announced that efforts to combat arms and ammunition smuggling at all borders are being pursued seriously. He urged those who have unknowingly acquired weapons to voluntarily surrender them. This measure aims to prevent potential issues and police monitoring.

The bulk carrier Cape Dao, flying the flag of Antigua and Barbuda, sank near the Strait of Hormuz. The ship had been hit by a projectile on October 1. Earlier, the container ship GFS Pride also caught fire and sank after an attack.

Alisina Mostafavi, a mountaineer and tar player, was executed on Wednesday, October 14. The judiciary labeled him a member of the 'Eternal Guard' and responsible for organizing two armed operations. Reports indicate he was forced to confess under torture.

Farzin Nadimi said the likelihood of a third war between Iran and Israel is very close. The US and Israel prefer any military action to occur after the elections in both countries. In case of war, Israel will likely focus on Iran's missile bases and drones will play an active role.

The head of North Khorasan University of Medical Sciences announced a shortage of 242 nurses in the province's medical centers. Despite an increase of 66 nursing staff compared to last year, the current number is still insufficient. The nurse-to-active-bed ratio is about one, and the shortage may affect the quality of care.
Today, the execution of a man accused of killing his wife, Mansoureh Ghadiri Javid, was carried out. Mansoureh Ghadiri Javid was a journalist and researcher. This sentence had been previously issued.

The Hormozgan governor's office announced that an unidentified drone hit a boat in Sirik County on Wednesday morning, October 14. The incident injured three people. Local residents removed the injured from the boat and took them to the shore.

Seventy-five contract workers of the West Azerbaijan Regional Water Company reported 6 to 7 months of unpaid wages. Workers at the Beshagard water treatment plant project have also not received six months of salary and benefits. Both groups have called for officials to address the issue.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, the Speaker of the Parliament, said in a video message that both fighting and negotiating are necessary. He emphasized that war should be conducted with full strength and military victories should be consolidated politically. The goal is for the enemy to either accept the demands or admit defeat.

Amir Mahmoud Davoudinejad, public relations manager of Lorestan Football Board, insulted journalists during Mehdi Tartar's press conference after the Persepolis vs. Khaybar Khorramabad match, causing a verbal altercation.

The disciplinary committee of the Spanish Football Federation suspended Vinicius Junior for four matches due to pulling Nathan Saliba's hair and protesting to the referee. He will miss matches against Sevilla, Barcelona, Racing, and Valencia. The suspension includes two matches for violent conduct and two matches for protesting to the referee.

Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Al-Zaidi emphasized in a meeting with Mohammed bin Salman that Iraq will not allow its territory to be used for attacks against Saudi Arabia or other regional countries. He also condemned the attack on King Khalid International Airport and harm to civilians. This meeting followed a drone attack on a Saudi oil pipeline, which Iraq acknowledged responsibility for after investigations.

Emmanuel Macron, the President of France, will travel to Kuwait, the UAE, Bahrain, and Qatar from October 19 to 21. He will meet with the leaders of these countries during his visit. The discussions will focus on the situation in the Strait of Hormuz and its impact on energy prices.
Netanyahu warned about Tehran's movements. He stated that they will overthrow the Iranian government. This was mentioned in the audio version of Titraval with Niusha Saremi.

A shopkeeper criticized in a video that his business was quickly sealed while the government delays payment of claims under the ration card plan. He says his dues remain unpaid. This video has gained attention on social media.

In five work-related incidents in Kashmar, Mahabad, Bam, Mashhad, and Isfahan, one worker died and eight others were injured. The accidents included getting caught in a press machine, roof collapse, burns, falling from height, and hand entrapment in a mixer. The injured include workers and firefighters.

Yahya Sari, the Houthi spokesperson, announced that the group targeted King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh with a ballistic missile. They also targeted a gathering of Saudi forces in Yemen with three ballistic missiles, causing casualties and damage. Saudi officials have not yet confirmed these claims.

A group of job-seeking youth from the city of Har in Shush gathered in front of the Sugarcane Development and Related Industries Company in Ahvaz. They demanded attention to their employment demands and the provision of job opportunities at the Haft Tappeh Sugarcane Agro-Industry Company.

Medical costs in Iran have risen sharply, and many people cannot afford them. Some patients are forced to endure pain and use weaker medications due to high expenses. People protest the payment of billions of dollars to Hezbollah while they themselves face severe economic hardships.

The execution of a man convicted of killing a student in Tehran was carried out today. The sentence relates to the case of a student's murder. The execution has been confirmed by judicial authorities.

The Jerusalem Post, citing regional diplomats, reported that Islamic Republic leaders believe another US attack on Iran is inevitable, and the main question is the timing. After talks with senior officials, the diplomats said concerns in Tehran have grown over the short period of relative calm and the resumption of conflicts.

Ali Shirazi from Iran International pointed to escalating disagreements in Tehran over the causes of the Islamabad agreement's failure. Gholamhossein Karbaschi identified the attack on three ships in the Strait of Hormuz as the reason for the agreement's violation. The spokesperson of the Revolutionary Guards rejected this narrative.

Tractor Sazi Tabriz club extended Alireza Beiranvand's contract for three more seasons. This occurred after Beiranvand's dispute with the club's management and his apology video. In the video, Beiranvand apologized to the club owner, coaching staff, players, and fans.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that the Islamic Republic pursues negotiation simultaneously with war. The goal of continuing war and negotiation is to force the enemy to accept Tehran's demands or admit defeat. He emphasized that neither war nor negotiation is endless and that one must fight with full strength when necessary.

Jafar Miadfar, head of the country's emergency organization, stated that about 3,000 ambulances are worn out and need to be renewed. The renewal depends on the participation of provincial governments. In Hamadan, 16 ambulances have been purchased in the past month, and four more are being bought.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International criticizing the long simultaneous power and water outages in the heat of Chabahar. He stated that this situation is not the right of the people. This issue has caused public dissatisfaction.
